notes.title: Water Spirit healing HotFix
notes.content: Fix a bug that made the game crash, when the water spirit loses its healing target

notes.title: Red Mercenary Language update - Russian Translation
notes.content:
Greetings Mercenary,

Red Mercenary is getting a language update. Russian is now available.

notes.title: Patch note v1.4.1
notes.content:
Greetings Mercenary,

This patch corrects the following bugs :

Crash when opening the Stat panel right after switching player class
Crash when dying in the game after switching player class
Big purple blocks that appear on level generation are now gone
Unding enemies (stuck at 0hp) have lost their holy protection

notes.title: Red Mercenary - Local multiplayer update
notes.content:
Greetings Mercenary,

Red Mercenary is getting a multiplayer update. Now you can play with your friend locally with a dynamic split-screen.

You can now add a second player when in single player mode (offline) via the pause menu.

notes.title: Red Mercenary Language update
notes.content:
Greetings Mercenary,

Red Mercenary is getting a language update. You can now select your language in the game. For now only French and Portuguese are available (others will come later).

This update also includes :

All enemies have new animations to smooth the on hit/attack state

notes.title: Visual update
notes.content:
Greetings Mercenary,

Red mercenary is getting a visual update for the town and for level background/foreground. 
Some enemies had the chance to have so new sprite and are now smoother in their movement.

notes.title: Spearman is joining Red Mercenary
notes.content:
Greetings Mercenary,

The spearman  is now joining the adventure. A spear master that can handle more spears than he has arms. 

This update also includes 

 New spawn animations and sounds
 Tweaked memory management during level generation 



You can follow me and give your feedbacks on Discord
